nodes.label: Product Requirements PDF v1.0
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0.pdf
nodes.description: Actual text extracted from all 28 PDF pages; required MVP baseline with explicitly deferred P1/P2 features.

nodes.label: Required Creator Uploader Ownership Policy
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0.pdf
nodes.description: Moment ownership stays with creator, media with uploader; current couple receives time-limited access, pet freezes and couple recap stops after unbind.
nodes.rationale: Separate access from ownership so relationship termination and deletion preserve each person's own content while ending mutual access.

nodes.label: Required On Demand Consent and Share Disclosure
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0.pdf
nodes.source_location: pp.15-16 REV-08 and SAFE-01; p.23 Section 9.1
nodes.description: Request media/save/reminder permissions in the action context; show names/dates/photos/text before sharing; rejection preserves a useful fallback.
nodes.rationale: User consent and export disclosure must remain explicit; external reminders are optional to core usability.

nodes.label: Planned Light Tasks PET08
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0.pdf
nodes.description: P1: at most three daily record/respond/interact tasks, skippable and without cumulative missed-day pressure.

nodes.label: Proposed North Star Metric
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0.pdf
nodes.source_location: p.4 Section 1.5; p.28 Effective Moment Definition
nodes.description: Count paired couples with at least three valid shared moments in the last 30 days; valid moments contain media or over 20 characters and are published, undeleted and successfully processed.

nodes.label: Deferred Personal Export SAFE07
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0.pdf
nodes.description: P1 personal-data export of creator-owned records and uploader-owned media using an expiring encrypted download package; roadmap places export in v1.2.
